g.text: LENGTH IS THE ORDERING LENGTH: THE SUM OF THE DETAILED OUT-TO-OUT DIMENSIONS INCLUDING HOOKS A AND G (ACI 315-99 SECTIONS 2.3 AND 4.2).
CUT IS THE CENTRELINE LENGTH THE BAR IS SHEARED TO. MASS IS TAKEN ON THE ORDERING LENGTH.
TOL. IS THE STANDARD FABRICATING TOLERANCE ON OVERALL LENGTH (ACI 315-99 FIGURES 8 AND 9). BEND IS THE 4.2(c) BENDING CLASS.
BENT BARS CARRY A MARK; A STRAIGHT BAR IS IDENTIFIED BY ITS SIZE AND LENGTH (ACI 315-99 SECTION 3.5.2).
